name: Adversarial Compute Amplification
description: Attacker-controlled batch_size/recursive/fan_out request metadata is interpreted as execution cardinality, so a single accepted request expands into nested model and tool calls and exhausts a shared compute budget before any per-request cap is applied.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*\b(?:unit test|test fixture|scanner rule|security training|incident report|postmortem|blocked payload|must not|do not|never)\b)(?=.*\b(?:batch(?:_size| size)?|fan[- ]?out|recursive|expand(?:s|ed|ing)?|repeat(?:s|ed|ing)?|nested)\b)(?=.*\b(?:model calls?|tool calls?|inference|requests?|jobs?|tasks?)\b)(?=.*\b(?:unbounded|without a limit|ignore the cap|no limit|exhaust|overload|starve|compute budget|resource budget|expensive)\b).*$
